Measure<TSource>(TSource, int, ReadOnlySpan<char>, int)

Widest cell of column (and header) over the first maxRows rows. O(rows): call it when the data changes and cache the result as Tuinet.Constraint.Length(System.Int32), not every frame. Add 2 for a column that shows a sort arrow.
